title: Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon review: nearly 9,000 runners on 19 October 2025, the series' first full marathon, and who the field was. What to expect in 2026.
dek: The ISOPLUS Run Series added a full marathon for the first time in Surabaya in October 2025, and nearly 9,000 runners turned up. Here is what that edition was like, and what it means for the 2026 race.
verdict: The Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon is a big brand race that became a marathon only recently. The 2025 edition, on Sunday 19 October, drew nearly 9,000 runners and was the first time the ISOPLUS Run Series offered a full 42 km [1]. The field was mostly shorter-distance runners: 44% in the 5 km and 33% in the 10 km, with 18% in the half and 4% in the marathon [1]. The city backed it heavily, with the mayor saying the route, security and cleaning had all been prepared [1]. If you want a well-supported city race in Surabaya, especially over 5 km to 21 km, it is a good choice. The marathon is young, and its field is small.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The race was held on Sunday 19 October 2025 in Surabaya and drew nearly 9,000 runners from across Indonesia [1]. It was the first time the ISOPLUS Run Series included a full marathon [1].

The shorter distances dominated: 44% of runners chose the 5 km, 33% the 10 km, 18% the half marathon and 4% the full marathon [1]. Just under half of the field, 44%, came from Surabaya, and 59.2% were men [1].

sections.heading: A City-Backed Race
paragraphs: Surabaya mayor Eri Cahyadi said the city had prepared the route survey, security and cleaning for the race, and that it showed Surabaya as a safe and clean city [1]. He said Surabaya could become a national marathon destination [1].
The organiser, WINGS Group's ISOPLUS brand, ran a six-month build-up from April with community training sessions, a professional coach and a nutritionist [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: If you want a large, well-supported race in Surabaya over 5 km, 10 km or 21 km, yes. The city's backing shows in the planning, and a field of 9,000 brings atmosphere.
If you want the marathon, be aware that it was new in 2025 and drew only about 4% of the field. Expect a thinner field over 42 km than over the shorter distances.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon in 2025?
faqs.answer: Nearly 9,000 runners took part on Sunday 19 October 2025. 44% ran the 5 km, 33% the 10 km, 18% the half marathon and 4% the full marathon, which was offered for the first time that year.

faqs.question: Does the Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon have a full marathon?
faqs.answer: Yes, since 2025. That year was the first time the ISOPLUS Run Series included a 42 km, alongside the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and a kids' dash. The full marathon drew about 4% of the nearly 9,000 runners.

faqs.question: Who organises the Surabaya ISOPLUS Marathon?
faqs.answer: WINGS Group, through its ISOPLUS drinks brand, with strong support from the Surabaya city government. In 2025 the organisers ran six months of community training sessions before race day.
